delegateRunResult.finding: ODG CAPABILITY GAP (pre-existing): the delegate flow observes conformance on an UNCOMMITTED patch but its verify gate requires a CLEAN tree, so a delegated patch can never pass verify→converge→archive in one run; and the verify build gate is a full Next.js build even for a docs-only mission. Not worked around (no commit-before-conformance, no weakened gate). Integration of this mission therefore goes through the normal PR path (CI + independent inspection).
